### CVE-2022-0247 — Write access to VMO data through copy-on-write in Fuchsia
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-02-25 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-732 CWE-732 Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An issue exists in Fuchsia where VMO data can be modified through access to copy-on-write snapshots. A local attacker could modify objects in the VMO that they do not have permission to. We recommend upgrading past commit d97c05d2301799ed585620a9c5c739d36e7b5d3d or any of the listed versions.

Affected:
- Google LLC / Fuchsia: affected unspecified <4.1 (custom)

References:
- https://fuchsia.googlesource.com/fuchsia/+/d97c05d2301799ed585620a9c5c739d36e7b5d3d [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2022-1941 — Out of Memory issue in ProtocolBuffers for cpp and python
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-09-22 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-1286 CWE-1286: Improper Validation of Syntactic Correctness of Input
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A parsing vulnerability for the MessageSet type in the ProtocolBuffers versions prior to and including 3.16.1, 3.17.3, 3.18.2, 3.19.4, 3.20.1 and 3.21.5 for protobuf-cpp, and versions prior to and including 3.16.1, 3.17.3, 3.18.2, 3.19.4, 3.20.1 and 4.21.5 for protobuf-python can lead to out of memory failures. A specially crafted message with multiple key-value per elements creates parsing issues, and can lead to a Denial of Service against services receiving unsanitized input. We recommend upgrading to versions 3.18.3, 3.19.5, 3.20.2, 3.21.6 for protobuf-cpp and 3.18.3, 3.19.5, 3.20.2, 4.21.6 for protobuf-python. Versions for 3.16 and 3.17 are no longer updated.

Affected:

### CVE-2022-2327 — Use-after-free in io_uring ad work_flags in Linux Kernel
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-07-22 | Updated: 2026-10-14 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

io_uring use work_flags to determine which identity need to grab from the calling process to make sure it is consistent with the calling process when executing IORING_OP. Some operations are missing some types, which can lead to incorrect reference counts which can then lead to a double free. We recommend upgrading the kernel past commit df3f3bb5059d20ef094d6b2f0256c4bf4127a859

Affected:
- Linux Kernel / Linux Kernel: affected unspecified <df3f3bb5059d20ef094d6b2f0256c4bf4127a859 (custom)
- Siemens / SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP - GNU/Linux subsystem: affected 0 <V1.1 (custom)

### CVE-2022-2347 — Unchecked Download size in Uboot
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-09-23 | Updated: 2026-05-12 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: CWE-122 CWE-122 Heap-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

There exists an unchecked length field in UBoot. The U-Boot DFU implementation does not bound the length field in USB DFU download setup packets, and it does not verify that the transfer direction corresponds to the specified command. Consequently, if a physical attacker crafts a USB DFU download setup packet with a `wLength` greater than 4096 bytes, they can write beyond the heap-allocated request buffer.

Affected:
- Uboot / Uboot: affected unspecified <=2022.07 (custom)
- Siemens / RUGGEDCOM ROX MX5000: affected 0 <V2.17.1 (custom)
- Siemens / RUGGEDCOM ROX MX5000RE: affected 0 <V2.17.1 (custom)

### CVE-2022-2503 — Linux Kernel LoadPin bypass via dm-verity table reload
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-08-12 | Updated: 2026-10-14 | Max CVSS: 6.9
- CWE: CWE-302 CWE-302 Authentication Bypass by Assumed-Immutable Data
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.9 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Dm-verity is used for extending root-of-trust to root filesystems. LoadPin builds on this property to restrict module/firmware loads to just the trusted root filesystem. Device-mapper table reloads currently allow users with root privileges to switch out the target with an equivalent dm-linear target and bypass verification till reboot. This allows root to bypass LoadPin and can be used to load untrusted and unverified kernel modules and firmware, which implies arbitrary kernel execution and persistence for peripherals that do not verify firmware updates. We recommend upgrading past commit 4caae58406f8ceb741603eee460d79bacca9b1b5

Affected:
- Linux Kernel / Linux Kernel: affected unspecified <4caae58406f8ceb741603eee460d79bacca9b1b5 (custom)
- Siemens / SIMATIC S7-1500 TM MFP - GNU/Linux subsystem: affected 0 <V1.1 (custom)

- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20230214-0005/
- https://cert-portal.siemens.com/productcert/html/ssa-794697.html

### CVE-2022-2566 — Heap-memory write in FFMPEG
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-09-23 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 9
- CWE: CWE-122 CWE-122 Heap-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A heap out-of-bounds memory write exists in FFMPEG since version 5.1. The size calculation in `build_open_gop_key_points()` goes through all entries in the loop and adds `sc->ctts_data[i].count` to `sc->sample_offsets_count`. This can lead to an integer overflow resulting in a small allocation with `av_calloc()`. An attacker can cause remote code execution via a malicious mp4 file. We recommend upgrading past commit c953baa084607dd1d84c3bfcce3cf6a87c3e6e05

Affected:
- FFMPEG / FFMPEG: affected 5.1 <unspecified (custom); affected ab77b878f1205225c6de1370fb0e998dbcc8bc69 <unspecified (custom); affected unspecified <c953baa084607dd1d84c3bfcce3cf6a87c3e6e05 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/c953baa084607dd1d84c3bfcce3cf6a87c3e6e05 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2022-3008 — Command Injection on tinygltf
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-09-05 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-78 CWE-78 OS Command Injection
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

The tinygltf library uses the C library function wordexp() to perform file path expansion on untrusted paths that are provided from the input file. This function allows for command injection by using backticks. An attacker could craft an untrusted path input that would result in a path expansion. We recommend upgrading to 2.6.0 or past commit 52ff00a38447f06a17eab1caa2cf0730a119c751

Affected:
- syoyo / tinygltf: affected unspecified <2.6.0 (custom)

### CVE-2022-3095 — Incorrect parsing of the backslash characters in Dart library
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-10-27 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20 Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

The implementation of backslash parsing in the Dart URI class for versions prior to 2.18 and Flutter versions prior to 3.30 differs from the WhatWG URL standards. Dart uses the RFC 3986 syntax, which creates incompatibilities with the '\' characters in URIs, which can lead to auth bypass in webapps interpreting URIs. We recommend updating Dart or Flutter to mitigate the issue.

Affected:
- Google LLC / Dart: affected stable <2.18.2 (custom); affected Flutter <3.3.3 (custom)

Credits: Sohom Datta, Cryptonite, MIT Manipal

References:
- https://github.com/dart-lang/sdk/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#2182---2022-09-28

### CVE-2022-3176 — Use-after-free in io_uring in Linux Kernel
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-09-16 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

There exists a use-after-free in io_uring in the Linux kernel. Signalfd_poll() and binder_poll() use a waitqueue whose lifetime is the current task. It will send a POLLFREE notification to all waiters before the queue is freed. Unfortunately, the io_uring poll doesn't handle POLLFREE. This allows a use-after-free to occur if a signalfd or binder fd is polled with io_uring poll, and the waitqueue gets freed. We recommend upgrading past commit fc78b2fc21f10c4c9c4d5d659a685710ffa63659

Affected:
- Linux / Kernel: affected unspecified <fc78b2fc21f10c4c9c4d5d659a685710ffa63659 (custom)

Credits: Bing-Jhong Billy Jheng <billy@starlabs.sg>

References:
- https://kernel.dance/#fc78b2fc21f10c4c9c4d5d659a685710ffa63659
- https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/stable/linux.git/commit?h=linux-5.4.y&id=fc78b2fc21f10c4c9c4d5d659a685710ffa63659
- https://www.debian.org/security/2022/dsa-5257 [vendor-advisory]
- https://lists.debian.org/debian-lts-announce/2022/11/msg00001.html [mailing-list]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20230216-0003/

### CVE-2022-3509 — Parsing issue in protobuf textformat
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-11-01 | Updated: 2025-04-22 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-400 CWE-400 Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A parsing issue similar to CVE-2022-3171, but with textformat in protobuf-java core and lite versions prior to 3.21.7, 3.20.3, 3.19.6 and 3.16.3 can lead to a denial of service attack. Inputs containing multiple instances of non-repeated embedded messages with repeated or unknown fields causes objects to be converted back-n-forth between mutable and immutable forms, resulting in potentially long garbage collection pauses. We recommend updating to the versions mentioned above.

Affected:
- Google / ProtocolBuffers: affected 3.21.0 <3.21.7 (semver); affected 3.20.0 <3.20.3 (semver); affected 3.19.0 <3.19.6 (semver); affected 3.16.0 <3.16.3 (semver)

References:
- https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/commit/a3888f53317a8018e7a439bac4abeb8f3425d5e9

### CVE-2022-3708 — Web Stories <= 1.24.0 - Server Side Request Forgery
- Assigner: Wordfence | Published: 2022-10-28 | Updated: 2026-04-08 | Max CVSS: 9.6
- CWE: CWE-918 CWE-918 Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.6 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

The Web Stories plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery in versions up to, and including 1.24.0 due to insufficient validation of URLs supplied via the 'url' parameter found via the /v1/hotlink/proxy REST API Endpoint. This makes it possible for authenticated users to make web requests to arbitrary locations originating from the web application and can be used to query and modify information from internal services.

Affected:
- google / Web Stories: affected 0 <=1.24.0 (semver)

Credits: Aymen Borgi

### CVE-2022-3910 — Use after free in IO_uring in the Linux Kernel
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-11-22 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-416 CWE-416 Use After Free
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Use After Free vulnerability in Linux Kernel allows Privilege Escalation. An improper Update of Reference Count in io_uring leads to Use-After-Free and Local Privilege Escalation.
When io_msg_ring was invoked with a fixed file, it called io_fput_file() which improperly decreased its reference count (leading to Use-After-Free and Local Privilege Escalation). Fixed files are permanently registered to the ring, and should not be put separately.

We recommend upgrading past commit  https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/fc7222c3a9f56271fba02aabbfbae999042f1679 https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/fc7222c3a9f56271fba02aabbfbae999042f1679

- Linux / Linux Kernel: affected 5.18.0 <=5.19.10 (custom)

### CVE-2022-4696
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2023-01-11 | Updated: 2024-08-03 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-763 CWE-763 Release of Invalid Pointer or Reference
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

There exists a use-after-free vulnerability in the Linux kernel through io_uring and the IORING_OP_SPLICE operation. If IORING_OP_SPLICE is missing the IO_WQ_WORK_FILES flag, which signals that the operation won't use current->nsproxy, so its reference counter is not increased. This assumption is not always true as calling io_splice on specific files will call the get_uts function which will use current->nsproxy leading to invalidly decreasing its reference counter later causing the use-after-free vulnerability. We recommend upgrading to version 5.10.160 or above


Affected:
- Linux / Linux Kernel: affected 5.7-rc1 <=5.10.159 (custom)
- linux / linux_kernel: affected 5.7-rc1 <=5.10.159 (custom)

Credits: Bing-Jhong Billy Jheng of Starlabs

### CVE-2022-41853 — Remote code execution in HyperSQL DataBase
- Assigner: Google | Published: 2022-10-06 | Updated: 2025-04-21 | Max CVSS: 8
- CWE: CWE-470 CWE-470 Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Those using java.sql.Statement or java.sql.PreparedStatement in hsqldb (HyperSQL DataBase) to process untrusted input may be vulnerable to a remote code execution attack. By default it is allowed to call any static method of any Java class in the classpath resulting in code execution. The issue can be prevented by updating to 2.7.1 or by setting the system property "hsqldb.method_class_names" to classes which are allowed to be called. For example, System.setProperty("hsqldb.method_class_names", "abc") or Java argument -Dhsqldb.method_class_names="abc" can be used. From version 2.7.1 all classes by default are not accessible except those in java.lang.Math and need to be manually enabled.

Affected:
- HyperSQL DataBase / hsqldb: affected unspecified <2.7.1 (custom)
